regions.today: It will be mostly cloudy this evening with rain developing across the north and west of the province and gradually spreading eastwards, in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy tonight with rain, drizzle and mist continuing to spread eastwards, becoming lighter and patchier as they do. The rain and drizzle will clear to showers later. Mild, with lowest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees in mostly moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: It will be a rather cloudy start to tomorrow, Tuesday, with some scattered showers in the morning. It will brighten up from the northwest through the afternoon with sunny spells developing. Cooler than recent days, with highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate, high in sunshine on Tuesday. Moderate on Wednesday.
